name: Groundwork Core
purpose: The base every project gets, whatever it is: project definition, agent instructions, product and system requirements with traceable IDs, the architecture starting point, decisions and the shared checks. Always active; profiles add to it and never change it. A project starts with PROJECT.md and AGENTS.md only; every other document is written from its template once there is something to put in it.

documents.when: The project handles user data, accounts, payments, secrets or anything worth attacking.
The project has code that needs more than one kind of test.
You are choosing how to lay out the repository: one repository or several, and where each app and package lives.
The product has a visual or interactive interface.
An interface has several consumers, outside teams or versioning needs, so it needs a written contract.
The project is on GitHub and you want the documentation checked on every push and pull request.
The project takes pull requests and you want each one to name the requirements it serves.
